name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Solar eclipse to occur next week. Here is what to know
changes.summary: It will be visible in parts of the U.S. on Wednesday. (Image credit: Edward M. Pio Roda).

changes.title: Verizon mobile service restored after outage for thousands of customers in the U.S.
changes.summary: Customers still having trouble with their service should restart their devices, the wireless carrier said. Verizon did not provide ⁠a reason for ⁠the outage.

changes.title: These are the "super scooper" firefighting seaplanes dousing European and U.S. wildfires
changes.summary: As wildfires rage in parts of the United States and Europe, firefighting efforts have taken to the seas and skies. CBS Saturday Morning takes a look at these remarkable "super scooper" amphibious aircraft.

changes.title: Why Rhode Island may oust a sitting governor over a bridge
changes.summary: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee has a month to turn around primary challenger Helena Foulkes’ 20-point lead or become the first sitting U.S. governor to lose a primary in eight years. The race represents another crest in the world’s post-pandemic anti-incumbent wave, which has transcended ideological lines as voters expres.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
changes.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.

changes.title: Iran issues new demands over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran on Saturday issued a new list of demands to the United States, complicating efforts to reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports from Doha.

changes.title: The U.S. Army Is Fast-Tracking New Weapons as Trump Denies Shortages
changes.summary: As the first company to utilize the U.S. Army's new test range scheduling system, Covenant Industries tested its Anthem missile on Aug. 6, 2026, at the Multidomain Training Area range complex in Morocco. —The U.S. Army via AP The U.S. Army said Friday that it is opening five military test ranges to private companies de.

changes.title: How winter canola could profit Illinois farmers, improve sustainability
changes.summary: A new simulation study from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign suggests winter canola could be profitable and environmentally beneficial if added to a conventional corn-soy rotation in the U.S. Midwest.

changes.title: Pentagon revokes security clearance of former Air Force chief
changes.summary: The Pentagon alleged that former U.S. Air Force Secretary Frank Kendall disclosed sensitive information about Air Force One's capabilities to the media.

changes.title: Iran Issues List of Demands, Dampening Hopes of Reopening Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: The head of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council said that the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed until the United States met certain conditions.
